description:
Kapy Notes is a fast, private notebook with a live calculator built into every line.

Write a thought, type a calculation, and see the result right beside it. There is no mode switching, formula setup, or separate calculator required.

WRITE THE WAY YOU THINK
• Notes, checklists, journals, meeting notes, and everyday scratch work
• Budgets, splits, percentages, estimates, and running totals
• Currency, unit, temperature, and time conversions
• Markdown-style headings, emphasis, lists, tables, links, images, videos, and voice notes
• Search, archive, protected hidden notes, export, and import

VOICE NOTES YOUR WAY
Record without an account. Choose local transcription to keep audio on your device, or sign in and deliberately enable cloud transcription. Local transcription and local summaries are unlimited. Cloud usage is shown clearly in Settings.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• Notes stay on your device unless you turn on sync
• Sync is end-to-end encrypted; we cannot read your notes
• Shared notes are encrypted for the people you share them with, by email or by link
• Block and report controls are built into sharing
• No ads, advertising identifiers, or cross-app tracking
• Close your account from inside the app whenever you like
• Works offline for notes and calculations

FOREVER FREE
Use every writing and calculation tool with up to five editable notes, 100 MB of storage, 15 minutes of cloud transcription each month, and 100 cloud summaries or rewrites each month. On-device transcription and summaries do not use those allowances. If you reach a limit, nothing is deleted and extra notes remain readable and exportable.

PRO LIFETIME
Every account begins with a 14-day Pro trial. No card is required and nothing renews. Pro Lifetime is one purchase, not a subscription. It unlocks unlimited notes, encrypted sync and sharing, 1 GB of storage, 120 cloud transcription minutes each month, and 1,000 cloud summaries or rewrites each month. Pro members can optionally buy repeatable 5 GB storage and 1,000-minute transcription packs through the App Store.

Currency exchange rates come from Frankfurter, with ExchangeRate-API as a fallback.
promotionalText: New: attach any file to a note, sketch on a drawing canvas, and find notes shared with you on their own tab.
whatsNew:
Attach any file to a note. Add one from the insert menu, the /file command, or the press-and-hold menu, and it is encrypted and synced like your pictures, within your plan's per-file limit. Tap a file to save a copy wherever you like. Large transfers no longer stop part way, and an interrupted upload picks up where it left off.

Turn a new, blank note into a drawing. Choose Draw in its corner for an endless canvas with a pen, rectangles, ellipses, arrows, lines, text, and an eraser, in six colours and three sizes, with undo and pinch to zoom. Each shape syncs on its own, so two people drawing on a shared note keep each other's strokes.

Once you are signed in, the notes list splits into My Notes and Shared with Me. Notes you share stay with your own, showing who can open them, and invitations wait under the search field with Accept and Decline.

Tables are steadier to edit: every keystroke stays in its cell, undo works straight away, and words typed just above or below a table stay out of it. The calculator now reads a value with words after a name, such as mailboxes = domains * 5 mail boxes, and lets any word be a variable you define with =. A new note you leave without writing in it is removed, and sync keeps devices in step on unsteady connections.

A web address inside a comment now keeps the comment's colour instead of standing out in orange, and pressing Delete on its own in the notes list with a keyboard no longer archives the highlighted note.
